lessons.title: Freshwater Pond Ecology, Water Chemistry & Fish Biology
lessons.titleSw: Ekolojia ya Mabwawa, Kemia ya Maji na Biolojia ya Samaki
lessons.outline: Freshwater pond ecology and primary productivity; diurnal cycles of photosynthesis and respiration (oxygen peak at 16:00, hypoxia crisis at 05:00); dissolved oxygen (DO) thresholds (minimum 5.0 mg/L for growth, emergency aeration below 3.0 mg/L); water temperature windows for Oreochromis niloticus (26-30°C) and Clarias gariepinus (25-30°C); pH scale (6.5 to 8.5) and total alkalinity as calcium carbonate buffering capacity; the nitrogen equilibrium in water: Total Ammonia Nitrogen (TAN), ionization fraction of lethal toxic free ammonia (NH3) versus non-toxic ammonium (NH4+) dictated by pH and temperature; nitrite (NO2-) toxicity, methemoglobinemia ('brown blood disease'), and chloride salt counter-measures; Secchi disk turbidity measurement and phytoplankton management (target 30-40 cm depth); earthen pond engineering: clay content testing (squeeze ball and ribbon tests, 20-35% clay), dyke slope ratios (2:1 interior, 1.5:1 exterior), pond bottom slope (1% toward drainage), monk sluice gates, and harvest sumps.

lessons.title: Hatchery Operations, Broodstock & Induced Spawning
lessons.titleSw: Uendeshaji wa Viatulio, Mifugo ya Mbegu na Upandishaji wa Kishawishi
lessons.outline: Broodstock selection and nutritional conditioning (minimum 35-40% crude protein feed); sexual dimorphism and visual sexing of Tilapia (papilla morphology) and Catfish (genital papilla shape and redness); the biology of Tilapia monosex all-male production: oral administration of 17α-methyltestosterone (MT) at 60 mg/kg feed to swim-up fry (under 11 mm) for 21 to 28 consecutive days; hormonal induction of African Catfish (*Clarias gariepinus*) using dried Carp Pituitary Gland (CPG) or synthetic GnRH analogues (Ovaprim / DHP at 0.5 mL/kg); intramuscular injection protocol; latency time calculation as a function of water temperature (degree-hours formula; 9-11 hours at 28°C); dry-method stripping of ova; milt collection and saline preservation; gamete activation with fresh water (60-second fertilization window); incubation systems (McDonald hatching jars, flow-through incubation troughs, kakaban mesh); yolk-sac fry absorption (48-72 hours) and first-feeding nutrition (Artemia nauplii, rotifers, and micronized egg-yolk emulsion).

lessons.title: Nutrition, Pearson Square Formulation & Feed Milling
lessons.titleSw: Lishe ya Samaki, Mfumo wa Pearson na Utengenezaji wa Chakula
lessons.outline: Fish nutritional physiology: amino acids as the primary energy source in carnivores and omnivores (unlike ruminants, fish preferentially oxidize protein for energy); crude protein (CP) requirements: fry 40–45%, grow-out Tilapia 25–30%, grow-out Catfish 35–40%; the concept of digestible protein and apparent digestibility coefficients (ADC); essential amino acids (lysine, methionine, threonine) and their primary dietary sources; key local feed ingredients: soybean meal (44–48% CP), fishmeal (60–72% CP, avoid un-dried locally produced meal), sunflower seedcake (34–38% CP), blood meal (80% CP, use at max 5% of diet), rice bran (12–14% CP, maximum 30% inclusion), maize grain (8–10% CP, energy carrier), BSF prepupae (Hermetia illucens: 40–44% CP DM, 30–36% crude fat); the Pearson Square method for balancing two-ingredient blends to a target protein level; farm-scale feed production steps: weighing, grinding to < 1 mm particle size, mixing, steam pelleting or ring-die extrusion, and solar-tray drying of finished pellets.

lessons.title: Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) & Biofiltration
lessons.titleSw: Mifumo ya Mzunguko wa Maji (RAS) na Uchujaji wa Kibiolojia
lessons.outline: The nitrogen cycle in RAS: fish metabolize dietary protein → excrete Total Ammonia Nitrogen (TAN) primarily through gill diffusion; Step 1 nitrification: Nitrosomonas europaea oxidizes NH3/NH4+ to nitrite (NO2-) consuming 3.43 g O2 per gram TAN; Step 2: Nitrobacter winogradskyi oxidizes NO2- to nitrate (NO3-) consuming 1.14 g O2 per gram NO2-; total oxygen consumption for complete nitrification = 4.57 g O2 / g TAN; hydraulic turnover rate: minimum 1 complete tank volume exchange per hour; solids removal as the first treatment step — swirl separators (passive radial flow separators achieving 60-80% TSS removal) and drum filters (80-95% removal); moving bed biofilm reactors (MBBR): high-density polyethylene (HDPE) K3 or Kaldnes media with 500 m² of protected surface area per m³ of media at 50-60% fill ratio; ammonia removal rate (ARE) 3.0 to 5.0 g TAN/m²/day depending on water temperature and DO; airlift pump design for combined aeration, circulation, and CO2 stripping; degassing column design; carbon dioxide accumulation (CO2 > 25 mg/L causes hypercapnia in fish); UV sterilization for pathogen control.

lessons.title: Coupled Aquaponics & Closed-Loop Deep Water Culture
lessons.titleSw: Kilimo Mseto cha Samaki na Mimea (Aquaponics) na Njia ya DWC
lessons.outline: The nitrogen cycle in aquaponics as the biological foundation: TAN → nitrite → nitrate via biofilm nitrification; plant roots assimilate nitrate (NO3-), ammonium (NH4+), phosphate (PO43-), potassium, calcium, magnesium, iron, and trace minerals; pH management (6.8 to 7.2 — the 'aquaponic sweet spot' balancing fish health and plant nutrient availability); plant production subsystems: (1) media beds — gravel or expanded clay (LECA) filled 30 cm deep, flood-and-drain using Affnan bell siphon auto-siphon; (2) Deep Water Culture (DWC) rafts: 25 mm polystyrene sheets floating on a 30 cm water channel, net pots holding plant root masses; (3) Nutrient Film Technique (NFT): thin film of nutrient solution flowing over bare roots in PVC half-pipes; fish-to-plant biomass ratio calculation (stocking 5-7 kg fish per m² of media bed as general rule of thumb); iron supplementation (chelated Fe-EDTA or iron filings in media bed); calcium and potassium deficiencies in fish-dominated systems; the Affnan bell siphon mechanics (standpipe height sets flood level, bell cap traps air, snorkel breaks siphon at drain level); PHOTO_CAPTURE practical assessment.

lessons.title: Lime Chemistry & Calcination Kilns
lessons.titleSw: Kemia ya Chokaa na Tanuri za Kuchoma
lessons.outline: The chemical lime cycle (CaCO3 -> CaO -> Ca(OH)2 -> CaCO3); calcination temperatures (850°C-1000°C) and enthalpy (+178 kJ/mol); limestone prospecting (acid effervescence test with 10% HCl or vinegar); vertical shaft mixed-feed kiln geometry (1:3 diameter-to-height ratio, tuyeres, refractory lining); slaking quicklime (highly exothermic reaction generating boiling heat and steam); safety PPE (chemical burn hazards from caustic CaO); hydraulic vs non-hydraulic lime; natural pozzolans (volcanic ash / pumice from the Rift Valley, pulverized clay brick dust).

lessons.title: Saponification — Soap & Glycerol Production
lessons.titleSw: Kutengeneza Sabuni na Glycerol (Saponification)
lessons.outline: Triglyceride ester hydrolysis equation (fat + 3 NaOH -> glycerol + 3 soap molecules); leaching potassium carbonate/hydroxide lye from hardwood ash (the floating egg density test); converting potassium lye to sodium hydroxide using slaked lime (causticization: K2CO3 + Ca(OH)2 -> 2 KOH + CaCO3); SAP (saponification) values of common oils (tallow, coconut, sunflower, palm); superfatting calculation (5%-8% excess oil for skin gentleness); cold-process method (trace identification, mould pouring, curing for 4-6 weeks); hot-process soap making and salt-out (graining) for pure soap curd and glycerol extraction.

lessons.title: Ethanol Fermentation & Fractional Distillation
lessons.titleSw: Uchachushaji wa Pombe na Utengenezaji wa Dawa kwa Kunereka
lessons.outline: Biochemical fermentation equation (C6H12O6 -> 2 C2H5OH + 2 CO2); feedstocks (sugarcane molasses, cassava/sweet potato starch conversion using malted barley amylase enzymes); yeast vitality (Saccharomyces cerevisiae, pH 4.5-5.2, 28°C-32°C); distillation vapor-liquid equilibrium (ethanol bp 78.3°C vs water 100°C); fractional distillation column design (reflux ratio, copper packing, height equivalent to theoretical plate - HETP); cut fractions: foreshots (toxic methanol at 64.7°C), heads (acetaldehyde, ethyl acetate), hearts (pure ethanol 78°C-82°C), and tails (fusel oils); the 95.6% azeotrope barrier; safe alcohol hydrometer (proof) testing.

lessons.title: Biodiesel Transesterification from Seed Oils
lessons.titleSw: Kutengeneza Mafuta ya Dizeli (Biodiesel) Kutoka Mbegu
lessons.outline: Transesterification stoichiometry (1 triglyceride + 3 alcohol -> 3 fatty acid esters + 1 glycerol); alcohol options (methanol vs bio-ethanol); catalyst selection (anhydrous NaOH or KOH); free fatty acid (FFA) titration using 0.1% NaOH and phenolphthalein/turmeric indicator; the soap problem (moisture + FFA forms soap, preventing separation); batch processor design (sealed 200L oil drum, water heater element, 55°C temperature control, circulation pump); gravity settling and bottom glycerol draining; bubble washing and dry washing with wood ash; the 3/27 conversion test (fuel quality verification).

lessons.title: Pyrolysis — Biochar, Pyroligneous Acid & Syngas
lessons.titleSw: Kuvunjika kwa Joto (Pyrolysis) — Mkaa Maalumu, Asidi ya Mbao na Gesi
lessons.outline: Thermal decomposition regimes (drying at 100°C-200°C, torrefaction at 200°C-300°C, exothermic primary pyrolysis at 300°C-500°C); mass balance split (30% biochar, 40% liquid bio-oil/wood vinegar, 30% non-condensable syngas); double-drum retort construction (55-gallon outer drum, 30-gallon inner feedstock chamber); condensing train (copper/iron tube in water trough) for raw pyroligneous acid collection; separation of wood tar from wood vinegar by settling; wood vinegar chemical composition (acetic acid, methanol, guaiacol, phenols) and agricultural dilution rates (1:500 foliar spray, 1:200 soil pest drench); syngas recirculation burner loops; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of workshop chemical apparatus or test setup.

lessons.title: CPTED & Defensible Space Architecture
lessons.titleSw: Muundo wa Mazingira Yanayozuia Uhalifu (CPTED)
lessons.outline: The four core pillars of CPTED (Natural Surveillance, Territorial Reinforcement, Natural Access Control, Maintenance/Management); concentric rings of defense (Zone 1: Far perimeter, Zone 2: Inner compound, Zone 3: Building shell, Zone 4: Hardened interior); sightline principles (the 2-metre/0.5-metre landscape rule); transition zones from public to semi-private to private; lighting geometry (glare avoidance, overlapping solar floodlights); eliminating concealment terrain and blind corners; community layout geometry (clustered homesteads vs isolated dwellings).

lessons.title: Physical Perimeter Barriers, Fencing & Hedgerows
lessons.titleSw: Vizuizi vya Mzunguko, Wigo na Mipaka ya Miiba
lessons.outline: Perimeter boundary clearance rules (3-metre inside clear zone, 10-metre outside buffer); corner post anchoring and H-brace mechanics (box brace vs diagonal stay); high-tensile barbed wire stringing and tensioning (80-100 kg tension per strand); concertina razor wire deployment (pyramid configuration: 2 bottom coils, 1 top coil); ditch-and-berm anti-vehicle earthworks (1.5m deep V-ditch, steep inward bank); living defensive hedgerows: plant selection (Euphorbia tirucalli, Agave sisalana, Carrissa edulis, Dovyalis caffra / Kei Apple); pruning and interweaving techniques; gate construction and heavy drop-pin hinge security.

lessons.title: Watchtowers, Lines of Sight & Early Warning Sensors
lessons.titleSw: Minara ya Ulinzi, Nyanja za Kuona na Vihisi vya Tahadhari ya Mapema
lessons.outline: Watchtower elevation physics: Earth curvature and visual horizon formula (d = 3.57 * sqrt(h)); timber tower framing (4-leg battered pole tower, diagonal X-bracing, covered observation platform); dead space mapping (identifying dry riverbeds, gully micro-terrain shadows); non-lethal early warning tripwires (monofilament fishing line, spring-loaded clothespin switches, mechanical 12-gauge blank perimeter trip alarms); 12V battery-powered PIR driveway alert beams; acoustic crunch gravel paths (clean 20 mm crushed granite); bio-sensory security: domestic animals as early detection alarms (Guineafowl, Geese, Livestock Guarding Dogs - LGDs).

lessons.title: Wildfire Defensible Space & Firebreak Engineering
lessons.titleSw: Nafasi ya Kuzuia Moto wa Nyika na Mistari ya Moto
lessons.outline: The Wildfire Triangle (fuel, oxygen, heat) and fire behavior factors (slope, wind, fuel moisture); the 3-Zone Defensible Space model: Zone 1 (0-1.5m Non-Combustible), Zone 2 (1.5-10m Clean & Green), Zone 3 (10-30m Fuel Reduction); firebreak width calculations based on flame length and wind speed; tractor disc plowing vs manual hoe trenches to bare mineral soil; wind-borne ember ignition physics and 3 mm non-combustible wire mesh screening for eaves/soffits; roof sprinkler systems fed by gravity tanks; fire-resistant landscaping plant selection (succulents, aloes, bananas).

lessons.title: Community Quick Reaction Protocols & Panic Rooms
lessons.titleSw: Mwitikio wa Haraka wa Jamii na Vyumba Salama vya Dharura
lessons.outline: Community defense organizational structure (watch commander, quick-reaction patrol, medical responders, civilian shelter marshals); acoustic alarm codes (siren / horn blasts for fire, medical, perimeter breach); internal safe room hardening: outward-opening steel-reinforced doors, continuous heavy hinge pins, three-point deadbolts, ballistic sandbag/gravel wall retrofits; safe room life support (independent water supply, N95 smoke respirators, chemical toilet, trauma first aid, secondary battery power, VHF radio with concealed antenna); rehearsed evacuation drills; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of a hardened entrance or perimeter.

lessons.title: Disease Transmission & the Epidemiological Triangle
lessons.titleSw: Uenezaji wa Magonjwa na Pembetatu ya Ugonjwa
lessons.outline: The epidemiological triangle (agent, host, environment); transmission routes (direct contact, droplet, airborne, faecal-oral, vector-borne, fomite); R0 and R_eff — what they mean for outbreak dynamics; herd immunity threshold formula; attack rate and case fatality rate; incubation period vs infectious period; the disease iceberg (symptomatic vs asymptomatic).

lessons.title: Oral Rehydration Therapy & Diarrhoeal Disease
lessons.titleSw: Tiba ya Maji kwa Mdomo na Magonjwa ya Kuhara
lessons.outline: Pathophysiology of secretory diarrhoea; WHO dehydration assessment (no dehydration, some dehydration, severe dehydration); WHO ORS formulation and home-made alternatives; ORT administration rates (Plan A, B, C); zinc supplementation evidence; BRAT/BRAF diet guidance; danger signs requiring IV fluids or hospital referral; cholera cot setup for mass casualty events.

lessons.title: Malaria — Lifecycle, Diagnosis & ACT Treatment
lessons.titleSw: Malaria — Mzunguko wa Maisha, Utambuzi na Matibabu ya ACT
lessons.outline: Plasmodium species (falciparum, vivax, malariae, ovale); Anopheles mosquito lifecycle and biting behaviour; clinical presentation (uncomplicated vs severe malaria); rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) — HRP2 antigen basis, procedure, and reading results; artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) dosing by weight; artemether-lumefantrine (AL) 6-dose regimen; danger signs requiring referral; insecticide-treated bed nets (ITNs) and indoor residual spraying (IRS).

lessons.title: Vaccination Cold Chain & Immunisation Logistics
lessons.titleSw: Mnyororo Baridi wa Chanjo na Usimamizi wa Kinga
lessons.outline: Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunisation (KEPI) schedule and antigens; cold chain temperature requirements (+2 to +8 degrees C, no freezing for most); freeze-sensitive vaccines (HepB, liquid pentavalent, HPV); vaccine vial monitor (VVM) stages and discard rules; cold box and vaccine carrier packing; temperature monitoring (Fridge-tag, manual log); open vial policy by antigen; vaccine wastage calculation and target rates.

lessons.title: Community Surveillance & Outbreak Response
lessons.titleSw: Ufuatiliaji wa Afya ya Jamii na Mwitikio wa Mlipuko
lessons.outline: Kenya IDSR framework — priority diseases and alert thresholds; community-level detection (rumour reporting, illness clustering); 24-hour reporting obligation and the case definition; contact tracing methodology and quarantine periods; isolation vs quarantine; setting up a community isolation space; line list documentation; outbreak communication — messaging families without panic; photo capture — community health register field practice.

lessons.title: Composting Latrines & Vermicomposting

lessons.title: AC Fundamentals — Single-Phase vs 3-Phase & Power Factor
lessons.titleSw: Misingi ya Umeme wa AC — Awamu Moja, Awamu Tatu na Power Factor
lessons.outline: Sinusoidal alternating waveforms (frequency, period, RMS voltage Vrms = Vpeak / sqrt(2)); single-phase 230V systems vs 3-phase 400V star (wye) and delta configurations; the line-to-line vs line-to-neutral relationship (V_LL = sqrt(3) * V_LN); neutral conductor currents and phase balancing; the AC power triangle: Real Power (P in kW), Reactive Power (Q in kVAR), Apparent Power (S in kVA); Power Factor (cos phi); inductive vs capacitive loads; calculating power factor correction capacitor banks to restore 0.70 PF up to 0.95 PF.

lessons.title: Alternators, Generators & Automatic Voltage Regulators
lessons.titleSw: Jenereta za Umeme, Alternator na Vidhibiti vya Voltage (AVR)
lessons.outline: Synchronous speed formula N = (120 * f) / P; 2-pole (3000 RPM) vs 4-pole (1500 RPM) alternators; revolving field vs revolving armature architectures; brushless exciter system (pilot exciter, rotating 3-phase rectifier diode bridge, main rotor field); loss of residual magnetism and 12V battery "field flashing" protocol; Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR) feedback loop, sensing transformers, and stability/voltage trimpot tuning; generator derating factors (ambient temperature, altitude > 1000m); troubleshooting low voltage, hunting oscillations, and diode failures.

lessons.title: Transformer Physics, Winding & Core Sizing
lessons.titleSw: Fizikia ya Transfoma, Kufuma Nyaya na Ukubwa wa Chuma
lessons.outline: Transformer induction laws and turns ratio formula (Vp / Vs = Np / Ns = Is / Ip); the electrical power loss equation P_loss = I^2 * R and why stepping up voltage cuts line losses by the square of voltage ratio; core physics (magnetic saturation Bmax, hysteresis, eddy currents in laminated silicon steel sheets); transformer design formula: E = 4.44 * f * Bmax * Ac * N; turns-per-volt calculation; copper wire circular mil / mm2 sizing based on 3.0 A/mm2 current density; insulating materials (Nomex paper, Kapton, baked polyurethane varnish); rewinding and testing open-circuit vs short-circuit parameters.

lessons.title: Distribution Panels, MCB/RCD Protection & Earthing
lessons.titleSw: Mbao za Usambazaji, Ulinzi wa MCB/RCD na Mfumo wa Earth
lessons.outline: Distribution board (Consumer Unit) internal architecture (busbars, main switch, neutral link, earth bar); Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB) dual trip mechanisms: thermal bimetallic strip (overload) vs magnetic solenoid (short circuit); MCB trip curves (Type B for lighting, Type C for general power/pumps, Type D for heavy welders/motors); Residual Current Devices (RCD): toroidal core differential current sensing, 30 mA human life safety threshold, 40 ms trip time; Earthing systems: TN-S, TN-C-S (PME), and TT isolated earthing; driving copper-clad earth rods; reducing earth resistance using bentonite clay and salt; earth loop impedance testing.

lessons.title: Micro-Grid Synchronization & Dynamic Load Shedding
lessons.titleSw: Kuunganisha Gridi Ndogo (Synchronization) na Udhibiti wa Mizigo
lessons.outline: Paralleling physics and the four mandatory synchronization conditions (voltage magnitude, frequency, phase sequence, phase angle); the classic 'three-lamp' synchronization method (dark lamp vs bright lamp); optical rotary synchroscopes; the breaker closing moment (11 o'clock slow clockwise rotation); real power sharing via Governor Speed Droop (4%-5% droop curve); reactive power sharing via AVR Voltage Droop; frequency-based dynamic load shedding tiers (Tier 1 clinic/comm, Tier 2 refrigeration/lighting, Tier 3 water pumping/milling); Electronic Load Controllers (ELC) and resistive dump loads for run-of-river hydro; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of electrical panel or generator wiring.

lessons.title: Radio Waves, Antennas & SWR
lessons.titleSw: Mawimbi ya Redio, Antena na SWR
lessons.outline:
1. The electromagnetic spectrum: HF (3–30 MHz), VHF (30–300 MHz), and UHF (300–3000 MHz)
2. Wavelength equation: Relating frequency to physical physical antenna size (λ = 300 / f)
3. The Half-Wave Dipole: Physical length formula (L = 142.5 / f) and center radiation resistance
4. The 1/4-Wave Ground Plane antenna: Vertical radiator with four 45-degree droop radials
5. Characteristic impedance: Why RF transmission lines are standardized at 50 Ohms
6. Standing Wave Ratio (SWR): Forward power vs reflected power (safe operating thresholds)
7. High SWR hazards: Thermal destruction of output RF final transistors (MOSFETs)
8. Antenna tuning & dummy loads: 50 Ω non-inductive resistor testing before live transmission

lessons.title: Handheld VHF/UHF & Field Protocols
lessons.titleSw: Redio za Mkono za VHF/UHF na Kanuni za Uwanjani
lessons.outline:
1. Handheld transceiver architecture: Antenna port (SMA), PTT button, volume/power, squelch
2. Simplex communication: Direct radio-to-radio on a single shared frequency
3. Repeater Duplex operation: Transmit offsets (+/- 600 kHz on 2m VHF; +/- 5.0 MHz on 70cm UHF)
4. Squelch mechanisms: Carrier squelch threshold vs CTCSS/DCS sub-audible tone decoders
5. The PTT (Push-To-Talk) technique: Press, pause one second, speak across the mic, release
6. Emergency message traffic: MAYDAY (life distress) vs PAN-PAN (urgency) vs SECURITE (safety)
7. The ICAO international phonetic alphabet and standard prowords (ROGER, OVER, OUT, SAY AGAIN)
8. Battery preservation: 1W Low-power discipline, 12V battery eliminators, and field solar charging

lessons.title: Long-Range HF & NVIS Propagation
lessons.titleSw: Mawasiliano ya Masafa Marefu ya HF na NVIS
lessons.outline:
1. The ionospheric layers: D-layer (daytime absorption), E-layer, and F1/F2 refracting layers
2. The Skip Zone dilemma: Ground wave fading at 30 km while skywave lands at 800 km
3. The NVIS principle: High-angle radiation (70°–90°) reflecting downwards like an umbrella
4. NVIS frequency window: Critical frequency (foF2) — 80m (3.5–4.0 MHz) night, 40m (7.0–7.3 MHz) day
5. The Low-Slung Dipole: Erecting a horizontal wire only 2 to 4 meters above ground
6. Ground reflector wire: Enhancing upward signal reflection by 3 dB
7. Continuous Wave (CW / Morse Code): 100 Hz bandwidth advantage over 2.8 kHz SSB voice
8. International distress Morse: S-O-S (... --- ...) transmission mechanics and tone recognition

lessons.title: Off-Grid Digital LoRa Mesh Networks
lessons.titleSw: Mitandao ya Kidijitali ya LoRa Mesh Nje ya Gridi
lessons.outline:
1. The LoRa revolution: Chirp Spread Spectrum (CSS) and decoding signals below noise floor (-20 dB)
2. Frequency allocation in Kenya: 433 MHz and 868 MHz ISM bands (license-exempt power limits)
3. The Meshtastic protocol: Decentralized flooding and managed mesh routing (zero internet required)
4. Node roles: Client (handheld with smartphone app), Router (permanent high-elevation relay)
5. Cryptographic security: AES-256 pre-shared keys for private channels and unencrypted broadcast nets
6. Hardware architectures: ESP32 + SX1262 (Heltec V3) vs Ultra-low-power nRF52 (RAK4631)
7. Solar repeater engineering: 5W solar panel + TP4056 charge controller + dual 18650 Li-ion cells
8. Offline data integration: Bridging LoRa text packets to offline local campus servers (Kiwix / PWA)

lessons.title: Antenna Masts, Lightning & Grounding
lessons.titleSw: Minara ya Antena, Radi na Upimaji wa Earth
lessons.outline:
1. The radio horizon equation: Calculating line-of-sight distance (D = 3.57 * (sqrt(h1) + sqrt(h2)))
2. Improvised antenna masts: Cured bamboo vs galvanized steel electrical conduit (EMT)
3. The 3-way guy wire geometry: 120-degree radial triangulation with earth screw anchors
4. Coaxial cable attenuation: RG-58 vs RG-213 vs LMR-400 (decibel signal loss per 10 meters)
5. The RF Choke (Ugly Balun): Coiling coaxial cable to suppress common-mode outer-shield currents
6. Lightning physics: Step potential, side-flashing, and induced electromagnetic pulse (EMP)
7. Single-point grounding: Coaxial gas discharge arrestors, 16 mm² copper wire, and 2.4m earth rods
8. PHOTO_CAPTURE practical: Construct and document an antenna build or RF grounding installation

lessons.title: Haemorrhage Control & Tourniquet Application
lessons.titleSw: Udhibiti wa Kutoka Damu na Utumiaji wa Tourniquet
lessons.outline:
1. Blood loss physiology: classes of haemorrhage (I–IV) and their clinical signs
2. The haemorrhage control hierarchy: direct pressure → wound packing → tourniquet
3. Direct pressure: technique, duration, and when to escalate
4. Wound packing: improvised materials, packing technique, haemostatic agents
5. Tourniquet anatomy: commercial CAT/SOFTT-W vs improvised windlass tourniquet
6. Tourniquet application: limb selection, placement, tightening, time recording
7. Tourniquet myths debunked: ischaemia time, limb loss, when NOT to remove
8. Junctional wounds (groin, axilla, neck): pressure and improvised approaches

lessons.title: Airway & Breathing Management
lessons.titleSw: Usimamizi wa Njia ya Hewa na Kupumua
lessons.outline:
1. Anatomy of upper airway obstruction: the tongue, foreign bodies, secretions, and blood
2. Suspected spinal injury: Jaw-Thrust maneuver vs non-trauma Head-Tilt Chin-Lift
3. Airway clearance: digital sweep precautions, suction, and postural drainage
4. The Recovery Position (lateral recumbent): biomechanics and step-by-step procedure
5. Sucking chest wounds (open pneumothorax): pathophysiology and 3-sided occlusive dressings
6. Tension pneumothorax red flags: tracheal deviation, unilateral breath sounds, jugular distension
7. Rescue breathing and hands-only CPR fundamentals for adult bystanders
8. Choking protocols (Heimlich abdominal thrusts and back blows in conscious vs unconscious)

lessons.title: Burns, Scalds & Wound Care
lessons.titleSw: Kuungua, Kuchemka na Utunzaji wa Majeraha
lessons.outline:
1. Burn depth classification: superficial (1st), partial thickness (2nd), full thickness (3rd)
2. Total Body Surface Area (TBSA) estimation: Wallace Rule of Nines and the Palmar Method
3. Immediate emergency action: Stop the burning process, remove constricting jewellery
4. Cooling protocol: clean cool running water for 20 minutes (never ice or freezing water)
5. What NEVER to put on a burn: debunking toothpaste, eggs, flour, cow dung, and engine oil
6. Dressing and protection: plastic cling film wrap vs sterile non-adherent sheets
7. Fluid loss & shock: oral rehydration therapy (ORT) vs intravenous Ringer's Lactate
8. Wound irrigation: high-pressure saline flushing vs soaking, signs of wound infection (cellulitis)

lessons.title: Fractures, Dislocations & Improvised Splinting
lessons.titleSw: Mifupa Iliyovunjika, Kutoka na Splinting ya Kubuni
lessons.outline:
1. Fracture classifications: closed vs open (compound), greenstick, comminuted
2. The PMS check: Pulse, Motor function, and Sensory assessment before and after splinting
3. The Golden Rule of Splinting: immobilise one joint above and one joint below the fracture
4. Open fracture emergency management: sterile covering, no bone reduction into wound
5. Improvised splinting materials: branches, timber slats, folded cardboard, rolled blankets
6. Traction splinting concepts for mid-shaft femur fractures (anatomical splinting)
7. Sling and swathe techniques for collarbone (clavicle) and shoulder dislocations
8. Compartment syndrome recognition: the 5 Ps (Pain out of proportion, Pallor, Pulselessness, Paresthesia, Paralysis)

lessons.title: Patient Assessment & Improvised Evacuation
lessons.titleSw: Tathmini ya Mgonjwa na Uokoaji wa Kubuni
lessons.outline:
1. Scene safety and sizing up: hazards (electrical, fire, traffic, toxic gas)
2. The <C>ABCDE Trauma Algorithm: Catastrophic Bleeding, Airway, Breathing, Circulation, Disability, Exposure
3. Rapid Trauma Assessment (Head-to-toe DCAP-BTLS survey)
4. START Simple Triage: Green (Walking Wounded), Yellow (Delayed), Red (Immediate), Black (Expectant)
5. Mechanics of lifting: protecting the rescuer's spine and coordinating multi-bearer moves
6. Improvised stretcher designs: Blanket & Poles, Button-Shirt / Jacket Sleeves, Burlap/Sisal Sacks
7. Loading and securing a casualty onto a stretcher: Log-roll with manual in-line spinal stabilization
8. PHOTO_CAPTURE practical: Construct and document an improvised load-bearing stretcher

lessons.title: Hermetic Grain Storage: Keeping Maize & Legumes Safe
lessons.titleSw: Uhifadhi wa Nafaka kwa Hermetic: Kulinda Mahindi na Mikunde
lessons.outline:
1. Why grain rots: the post-harvest loss triangle (moisture, insects, fungi)
2. Hermetic principle: O₂ depletion and CO₂ build-up kill weevils in 7–14 days
3. PICS bags vs. triple-layer hermetic bags vs. metal silos — cost and capacity
4. Moisture testing: bite test, 105 °C oven method, and affordable moisture meters
5. Filling, sealing, and stacking — avoiding puncture failure
6. Aflatoxin risk: visual sorting and UV lamp inspection
7. Rodent-proofing: silo placement, pallet rules, cat/trap programmes
8. Opening safely: airing before re-entry into enclosed stores

lessons.title: Solar Drying: Fish, Fruits, and Vegetables
lessons.titleSw: Ukaushaji wa Jua: Samaki, Matunda, na Mboga
lessons.outline:
1. Water activity (Aᵥ) and microbial safety thresholds
2. Open-air vs. raised-rack vs. solar tunnel dryer — efficiency comparison
3. Solar tunnel dryer construction: materials, dimensions, ventilation
4. Pre-treatment: salting, blanching, lemon/ascorbic acid, sulphiting
5. Slicing geometry and surface-area-to-mass ratio
6. Fish drying: gutting, brining, fly control (muslin netting)
7. Dryness test and packaging for long storage
8. Rehydration and nutritional retention data

lessons.title: Lacto-Fermentation: Uji, Fermented Milk, and Vegetables
lessons.titleSw: Kuchacha kwa Lacto: Uji, Maziwa Yaliyochachushwa, na Mboga
lessons.outline:
1. Lactic acid bacteria (LAB): species, substrates, and environments
2. pH drop as a preservation mechanism — the 4.0 barrier
3. Uji wa togwa: sorghum/maize fermentation protocol (48–72 hours)
4. Mursik: traditional Kalenjin fermented milk — the gourd process
5. Vegetable fermentation: salt concentration, brine ratios, and anaerobic sealing
6. Fermented cassava (kivunde/gari): detoxification of hydrogen cyanide
7. Probiotic benefits: LAB and gut health evidence
8. Failure modes and how to recognise unsafe ferments

lessons.title: Salt & Smoke Preservation: Meat, Fish, and Hides
lessons.titleSw: Uhifadhi wa Chumvi na Moshi: Nyama, Samaki, na Ngozi
lessons.outline:
1. Mechanisms: Aᵥ reduction by salt, phenolic deposition by smoke
2. Dry salting vs. wet brine curing — applications and ratios
3. Nitrite curing (sodium nitrate/nitrite) — the botulism connection
4. Hot smoking: temperature, time, and wood species
5. Cold smoking: temperature control and extended shelf life
6. Building a field smokehouse from clay, bricks, or sheet metal
7. Charqui / biltong / nyama choma wa kukaushwa: combined salt-dry method
8. Rancidity prevention: antioxidants and packaging

lessons.title: Seed Saving & Storage: The Foundation of Food Sovereignty
lessons.titleSw: Kuhifadhi Mbegu: Msingi wa Uhuru wa Chakula
lessons.outline:
1. Why seed saving matters: biodiversity, cost, and food sovereignty
2. Open-pollinated varieties (OPV) vs. hybrids — which seeds you can save
3. Isolation distances and preventing cross-pollination
4. Selection criteria: 10 % rule, performance traits, and negative selection
5. Extraction protocols: wet process (tomato, cucumber) vs. dry process (beans, maize)
6. Drying seed to the target moisture content (≤ 8 % for long storage)
7. Viability testing: germination test and tetrazolium (TZ) test
8. Long-term storage: temperature, humidity, containers, and the Rule of 100

lessons.title: Directional Felling, Chainsaw Physics & Sawlog Grading
lessons.titleSw: Kuangusha Miti kwa Usahihi, Fizikia ya Msumeno wa Moto na Upimaji Magogo
lessons.outline: Personal protective equipment (PPE: ballistic kevlar chaps, steel-toe boots, mesh visor helmet, hearing protection); chainsaw anatomy and safety features (inertia chain brake, chain catcher, throttle interlock); kickback physics: the upper quadrant of the guide bar tip (rotational energy vector); chain filing geometry (30° cutter top-plate angle, 0.025-inch depth gauge / raker height); assessing tree hazards (dead snags, rot, lean, crown weight distribution, wind speed); directional felling cuts: the Open-Face notch (70° opening, depth 20-25% diameter), the Bore Cut (plunge cut) to prevent barber-chairing on heavy leaning trees, and the Back Cut; holding wood hinge thickness rule (10% of DBH); felling wedges; establishing the 45° escape retreat route; sawlog grading and volume calculation (Huber's and Smalian's cubic volume formulas).

lessons.title: Timber Conversion — Pit Sawing & Chainsaw Mills
lessons.titleSw: Upasuaji Magogo — Misumeno ya Mashimo (Pit Sawing) na Mashine za Msumeno
lessons.outline: Log preparation: debarking to eliminate grit/stones, end-coating with wax to prevent drying checks; snapping parallel layout chalk lines; the mechanics of the Two-Man Pit Saw (long tapered blade, 2.0 to 2.5 m, rip-filed teeth cutting on the downstroke); crew roles: the Topman (steers line from above) and the Pitman (powers downstroke in the pit); portable Chainsaw Alaskan Mills: aluminum guide rails, clamp carriages; the physics of the Ripping Chain (10° cutter angle vs standard 30° crosscut, scoring wood along end grain); kerf width analysis (3 mm pit saw vs 9 mm chainsaw mill) and percentage recovery yields; sawing patterns: Plain/Through-and-Through vs Quarter Sawing.

lessons.title: Wood Anatomy, Moisture Physics & Solar Kiln Seasoning
lessons.titleSw: Anatomia ya Mbao, Fizikia ya Unyevu na Kukausha kwa Tanuri ya Jua
lessons.outline: Wood microstructure: Heartwood (dead, durable, dense) vs Sapwood (living, sap-filled, vulnerable to beetles); microscopic tracheids and vessels; the physics of wood moisture: Free Water (inside cell cavities) vs Bound Water (adsorbed chemically in cell walls); the Fiber Saturation Point (FSP = 28% to 30% MC) where shrinkage begins; Moisture Content formula: MC% = [(Wet Weight - Dry Weight) / Dry Weight] * 100; differential shrinkage ratio (Tangential 8% vs Radial 4% vs Longitudinal 0.1%); air drying stacking architecture (level foundation, 25 mm square stickers aligned vertically, overhang roofs, weighted stacks); greenhouse solar kiln construction (semi-transparent corrugated poly roof, black heat-absorber baffle wall, solar-powered 12V circulation fans).

lessons.title: Timber Preservation — Borates, Pyroligneous Tar & Termite Defense
lessons.titleSw: Kuhifadhi Mbao — Dawa ya Borate, Lami ya Asili na Kuzuia Mchwa
lessons.outline: The biological enemies of timber: Subterranean Termites (Macrotermes, workers building shelter mud tubes), Powder-Post Beetles (Lyctus, Bostrichidae infesting high-starch sapwood), and Brown Rot / White Rot fungi; chemical preservation classes: Water-Borne Borates (DOT: Disodium Octaborate Tetrahydrate) for interior framing, and Oil-Borne Preservatives (refined wood tar creosote from Day 5 pyrolysis + motor oil) for ground contact; the Boucherie Sap Displacement method (gravity tank displacing sap in green poles with copper sulfate/borate); hot-and-cold bath thermal soaking; the Char-and-Tar fence post protocol; mechanical termite shields (ant caps: 26-gauge galvanized steel turned down at 45°); building design biosecurity (200 mm clearance above grade).

lessons.title: Heavy Timber Joinery & Structural Truss Framing
lessons.titleSw: Viungio vya Mbao Nzito na Uundaji wa Paa za Truss
lessons.outline: Structural forces in timber frames: tension (pulling apart), compression (pushing together), and horizontal shear parallel to grain; the classic Mortise-and-Tenon joint (1/3 thickness rule, cheek layout, shoulder cutting); Draw-Boring mechanics (offset peg hole by 2-3 mm, tapered dry oak/acacia peg pulling the joint permanently tight under tension); the Scarf Joint (halved and bladed scarf with key) for splicing short logs into 12-metre ridge beams; the King Post Roof Truss (tie beam, principal rafters, king post in tension, compressive struts); birdsmouth rafter seat cuts; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of timber joinery, truss framing, or solar kiln.

lessons.title: Precision Measurement & Bench Work
lessons.titleSw: Vipimo Sahihi na Kazi za Benchi
lessons.outline: Vernier caliper reading and internal/external/depth measurement; outside micrometer calibration, ratchet thimble use, and zero-error correction; dial test indicators (DTI) and runout measurement; layout tools (scriber, prick punch, engineer's square, hermaphrodite calipers); file cuts (bastard, second cut, smooth), cross-filing, and draw-filing techniques; engineer's blue surface scraping for flat bearing surfaces.

lessons.title: Drilling, Tapping & Fasteners
lessons.titleSw: Kuchimba, Kutengeneza Nyuzi na Vifungo vya Mitambo
lessons.outline: Twist drill geometry (118° point angle, lip relief, web thinning); cutting speed formula RPM = (1000 × V) / (pi × D); pilot hole rules for drills over 10 mm; work holding safety and drill press vises; tap drill calculation formula (TDS = D - P); 3-piece tap set sequence (taper, intermediate/plug, bottoming); tap wrench technique and chip breaking (half-turn back); die stocks and external threading; metric bolt strength grades (4.8, 8.8, 10.9, 12.9) and torque tightening fundamentals.

lessons.title: Oxy-Acetylene Cutting & SMAW Welding Fundamentals
lessons.titleSw: Kukata kwa Gesi na Misingi ya Kuchomelea Chuma (SMAW)
lessons.outline: Oxy-acetylene equipment setup, cylinder identification (maroon acetylene, black oxygen), and flashback arrestors; lighting and adjusting flames (carburizing, neutral at 3100°C, oxidizing); oxygen cutting torch mechanics (preheat flames, cutting lever, exothermic iron-oxygen combustion); cutting defects (drag lines, slag adherence); SMAW fundamentals (DCEN vs DCEP polarity); AWS electrode numbering breakdown (E7018, E6013); joint prep (bevel angles, root gap, tack welds); common defects (porosity, slag inclusions, lack of fusion, undercut).

lessons.title: Power Transmission — Bearings, Shafts & Belt Alignment
lessons.titleSw: Usafirishaji wa Nguvu — Fani, Mihimili na Mipangilio ya Mikanda
lessons.outline: Bearing classifications and load vectors (radial vs axial/thrust); standard bearing numbering code system (e.g., 6205, 6308); bearing fits and mounting methods (induction heaters, hot oil baths at 110°C, mechanical bearing fitting tools — never press across rolling elements); shaft keyways (parallel, woodruff, feather) and failure modes; shaft alignment principles (angular vs parallel offset); straightedge, feeler gauge, and rim-and-face dial indicator methods; V-belt drive alignment, sheave wear, and tension testing (16 mm deflection per metre of span).

lessons.title: Micro-Hydro Turbine Fabrication & Balancing
lessons.titleSw: Kutengeneza Turbini ya Maji na Kusawazisha Mizania
lessons.outline: Impulse turbine fundamentals (Pelton vs Turgo vs Crossflow); Torricelli jet velocity equation V = sqrt(2 × g × H); bucket splitter edge physics and water redirection; runner pitch circle diameter (PCD) sizing; fabricated sheet metal / cast bronze bucket attachment; nozzle needle valves and deflector plates; static balancing on parallel knife edges; dynamic vibration analysis; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of workshop bench layout or fabricated component.

lessons.title: Iron Smelting & The Charcoal Bloomery Furnace
lessons.titleSw: Kuyeyusha Chuma na Tanuri ya Bloomery ya Mkaa
lessons.outline: The chemical thermodynamics of iron direct reduction (Fe2O3 + 3 CO -> 2 Fe + 3 CO2); identifying iron ores in East Africa (banded ironstone, red hematite laterite, black magnetite river sands); ore roasting and crushing; bloomery shaft furnace design (1.2 m height, 30 cm internal bore, 15° inclined ceramic tuyere); refractory furnace mud formulations (termite mound clay + quartz sand + dry straw); the 1,200°C solid-state sponge iron bloom vs liquid fayalite slag (2FeO·SiO2); furnace run sequence (preheating, charging 1:1 ore-to-charcoal ratio, continuous air blast); slag tapping protocols; extracting and heavy sledgehammer consolidation forging to squeeze out liquid glass slag.

lessons.title: Blacksmithing — The Forge Hearth, Anvil & Tool Crafting
lessons.titleSw: Uhunzi wa Chuma — Tanuri ya Uhunzi, Fuawe na Utengenezaji Zana
lessons.outline: The brake-drum charcoal forge hearth (tuyere pipe, ash dump, centrifugal blower / hand crank); blacksmith's anvil anatomy (face, round horn, step, hardy hole, pritchel hole); anvil mounting and rebound testing (bearing ball test > 80% rebound); steel incandescent temperature color chart (faint red 600°C to yellow/white 1,200°C); hammer dynamics (cross-peen hammer, drawing out length vs spreading width); upsetting to thicken bar stock; hot punching and drifting round/square eye holes (axes, hammers); making a pair of flat-jaw blacksmith tongs from scrap rebar; the physics of forge-welding (silica sand / borax flux, liquid oxide displacement, incandescent white heat @ 1,300°C).

lessons.title: Heat Treatment — Annealing, Normalizing, Quenching & Tempering
lessons.titleSw: Utireshaji Vyuma — Kupunguza Ugumu, Kurekebisha, Kuzima na Kutuliza
lessons.outline: Iron-carbon metallurgy: Ferrite, Cementite (Fe3C), Pearlite, and Austenite (face-centered cubic FCC at 727°C+); the critical transformation temperatures (A1 at 727°C, A3 curve); Full Annealing (slow furnace cooling to achieve machinable softness); Normalizing (air cooling to refine coarse forged grains); Quenching physics: the rapid shear transformation of Austenite into needle-hard Martensite (65 HRC); quench media selection (brine, water, canola/motor oil); Quench cracking and warping prevention; Tempering kinetics (sacrificing excess hardness to gain toughness); Oxide Temper Color spectrum (220°C pale straw for razors, 260°C brown for axes, 290°C blue for springs and cold chisels); differential tempering.

lessons.title: Greensand Mold Making & Pattern Engineering
lessons.titleSw: Utengenezaji wa Ukungu wa Mchanga (Greensand) na Sampuli za Vyuma
lessons.outline: The physical chemistry of Greensand (85-90% clean sub-angular silica sand, 8-10% sodium/calcium bentonite clay, 3-5% water); the hand-squeeze ball test for sand moisture; wooden pattern design rules: parting lines, draft taper angle (1° to 3°), and metal shrinkage allowances (1.3% for aluminium, 1.5% for bronze, 2.0% for cast iron); parting powder (talc, fine dry wood ash, graphite); molding flask anatomy (lower drag, upper cope, alignment register pins); ramming technique and venting needles; gating system engineering: pouring basin, tapered sprue, runner trap, ingates, and feeding risers (feeder heads) to eliminate internal shrinkage voids.

lessons.title: Crucible Furnace Operation & Non-Ferrous Casting
lessons.titleSw: Uendeshaji wa Tanuri ya Crucible na Uyahushaji wa Vyuma (Alumini na Shaba)
lessons.outline: Crucible furnace design: tangential burner inlet, refractory lining (kaolin / castable refractory, 1,300°C rated), forced-air waste oil or charcoal burner; clay-graphite and silicon carbide crucible selection and preheating (preventing spalling fractures); melting thermodynamics of Aluminium (660°C) and Silicon-Bronze (1,000°C); hydrogen gas solubility and degassing protocols (degassing tablets or dry table salt + potassium chloride flux); dross skimming tools; pouring ergonomics: two-man lifting shank and pouring tongs; absolute moisture safety rules (preheating all charging scrap and skimmers); shake-out inspection and cleaning; PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of workshop foundry mold, crucible melt, or finished cast component.

lessons.title: Topographic Maps, Contours & Grid Coordinates
lessons.titleSw: Ramani za Topografia, Mistari ya Miinuko na Kuratibu za Gridi
lessons.outline: Map scale ratios (1:50,000 standard survey sheet); representative fractions; contour lines (index contours, intermediate contours, supplementary); contour spacing vs terrain slope; the V-rule for river valleys and spurs; calculating slope gradient percentage: Slope% = (Rise / Run) * 100; Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) and Military Grid Reference System (MGRS); reading 6-figure and 8-figure grid references (Eastings before Northings); measuring curved trail distances with thread or map wheel.

lessons.title: The Magnetic Compass & Declination Mathematics
lessons.titleSw: Dira ya Sumaku na Hisabati ya Mkengeuko wa Kijiografia (Declination)
lessons.outline: The three Norths: True North (geographic rotation axis), Grid North (map UTM vertical lines), and Magnetic North (compass needle alignment); the marginal diagram declination diagram on topographic maps; Magnetic Declination and Grid Magnetic Angle (GMA); calculating annual magnetic change (drift rate in minutes of arc); the universal conversion formulas: "Grid to Mag: ADD if West / SUBTRACT if East"; lensatic and baseplate prismatic compass anatomy (sighting wire, prism optic, liquid capsule, dial damping); back-bearings formula (θ ± 180°); eliminating local magnetic attraction (rifles, steel vehicles, wristwatches, iron-rich basalt rock).

lessons.title: Field Resection, Triangulation & Position Fixing
lessons.titleSw: Kutambua Eneo Ulipo (Resection), Pembetatu na Upimaji wa Shambani
lessons.outline: The geometric principle of resection (sighting unknown position from known points); identifying distinct landmarks on map and terrain (peaks, radio masts, water towers, road junctions); taking precision magnetic bearings with a prismatic compass; converting to Grid Back-Bearings; plotting lines of position (LOP) with protractor; the 2-point resection vs the gold-standard 3-point resection; resolving the 'Triangle of Error' (cocked hat) using the rule of signs; using handrails, baselines, and catching features to prevent overshooting; aiming off technique.

lessons.title: Plane Table Surveying & Community Base Mapping
lessons.titleSw: Upimaji wa Jedwali la Ndege (Plane Table) na Kutengeneza Ramani za Jamii
lessons.outline: The Plane Table apparatus (hardwood drawing board, sturdy wooden tripod, 360° leveling head, trough compass, plumb-bob plumbing fork); the Alidade (sight rule with sighting vanes and fiducial edge); the 3 golden operations at every station: Leveling (circular spirit level), Centering (plumbing fork over ground peg), and Orientation (backsighting or magnetic trough compass); mapping methods: Method of Radiation (radial rays to nearby trees, corners, wells), Method of Intersection (triangulating distant peaks without visiting them), and Method of Traversing (walking closed polygon boundaries); closing error adjustments.

lessons.title: Dead Reckoning, Pacing Calibration & Night Navigation
lessons.titleSw: Uelekezaji Njia Gizani (Dead Reckoning), Upimaji wa Hatua na Anga ya Usiku
lessons.outline: The dead reckoning navigational triangle (Position = Known Origin + Vector Heading + Distance Traversed); pacing calibration methodology (measuring 100-metre baseline for flat, uphill, and thick scrub); constructing ranger pace-counting beads (tallying 100m and 1km units); obstacle bypassing techniques (the 90° box method and the optical point-aiming method); night compass techniques (bezel ring click intervals, tritium luminous markers, dead-reckoning buddy teams); southern hemisphere celestial navigation: Southern Cross (Crux) and Pointers (Alpha & Beta Centauri) true south projection; equatorial star tracking (Orion's Belt rising true East and setting true West); PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of field cartography, triangulation sketch, or pace tracking record.

lessons.title: Soil Composition & Foundation Sizing
lessons.titleSw: Muundo wa Udongo na Upimaji wa Msingi
lessons.outline:
1. Soil mineral fractions: gravel, coarse/fine sand, silt, and cohesive clay
2. The black cotton soil hazard: expansive montmorillonite clay in Kenya
3. Rapid field test 1: The ribbon test (extruding moist soil between thumb and finger)
4. Rapid field test 2: The drop ball test from 1.0 meter height
5. Definitive volumetric test: The 24-hour glass jar sedimentation test
6. Soil bearing capacities: bedrock vs gravel vs firm clay vs loose sand (kN/m²)
7. The Rubble Trench foundation: porous rock bed with perforated drain pipe
8. Stem wall (plinth) construction: elevating earthen walls at least 30 cm above ground grade

lessons.title: Compressed Earth Blocks & Stabilization
lessons.titleSw: Matofali ya Udongo Yaliyoshindiliwa na Uimarishaji
lessons.outline:
1. Environmental and economic comparison: Fired bricks vs quarry stone vs CEB
2. The mechanics of stabilization: Cement (for sandy soils) vs Lime (for clay soils)
3. Determining Optimum Moisture Content (OMC): The hand-squeeze ball test
4. Manual block pressing: Operation of the toggle lever press (Cinva-Ram mechanism)
5. The curing imperative: 14 to 28-day hydration under black polythene sheeting
6. Compressive strength standards: KS 02-1070 requirements (dry vs wet strength)
7. Mortar compatibility: Soil-cement slurry vs destructive rigid Portland mortars
8. Interlocking CEB (ISSB) designs: Mortarless tongue-and-groove construction

lessons.title: Earthbag & Superadobe Dome Mechanics
lessons.titleSw: Mifuko ya Udongo na Miundo ya Dome
lessons.outline:
1. Superadobe fundamentals: Woven polypropylene tubular bags + damp mineral subsoil
2. The tensile key: 4-point, 2-strand 12.5 gauge barbed wire between every course
3. Continuous tamping mechanics: Converting loose soil into dense rammed monoliths
4. The Compass Trammel: Using central pivot chains to control circular radius and corbelling
5. Catenary arch vs hemispherical dome: Directing all structural loads into pure compression
6. Opening mechanics: Constructing rigid wooden arch forms for doors and windows
7. Buttresses and shear walls: Stabilizing straight wall segments with intersecting curves
8. Exterior plaster coats: Scratch coat, brown coat, and lime/Opuntia cactus water-shedding finish

lessons.title: Timber Trusses & Thermal Insulation
lessons.titleSw: Paa za Mbao na Kuzuia Joto
lessons.outline:
1. Truss triangulation principles: Converting bending moments into pure axial tension/compression
2. The King Post Truss anatomy: Top rafters, horizontal tie beam, central king post, and diagonal struts
3. Timber species in Kenya: Cypress (Cupressus lusitanica), Blue Gum (Eucalyptus saligna), and Pine
4. Wood preservation: Boron salt diffusion (anti-termite/borer) vs copper naphthenate
5. Connection engineering: Through-bolts, 2 mm steel gusset plates, and galvanized hurricane ties
6. Wind uplift calculations: Why roofs blow OFF rather than collapse IN
7. The 60 cm overhang rule: Shading mud/CEB walls from torrential vertical rains
8. Passive convective cooling: Continuous ridge vents and ventilated double roofs

lessons.title: Ferro-Cement Engineering & Stormproofing
lessons.titleSw: Uhandisi wa Ferro-Cement na Kukabili Dhoruba
lessons.outline:
1. The ferro-cement principle: High specific surface area of reinforcement vs conventional RCC
2. Materials: 6 mm mild steel skeletal rebar + 4 layers of 12 mm hexagonal galvanized chicken wire
3. Mortar formulation: 1:2 to 1:2.5 Portland cement to clean quartz sand (water/cement ratio ≤ 0.40)
4. Workability without water excess: Using superplasticizers or liquid dish soap as field surfactant
5. The plastering sequence: Forcing mortar from both sides to eliminate internal voids
6. The 21-day underwater curing rule for zero-leakage water cisterns
7. Storm-resistant design: Aerodynamic rounded profiles that deflect 150 km/h wind shear
8. PHOTO_CAPTURE practical: Construct and document a ferro-cement or stabilized earth structural specimen

lessons.title: PV Fundamentals & Panel Selection
lessons.titleSw: Misingi ya PV na Uchaguzi wa Paneli
lessons.outline:
1. The photovoltaic effect: how a silicon p-n junction converts photons to current
2. The I-V curve: Isc, Voc, Vmp, Imp, and maximum power point (MPP)
3. Reading a panel datasheet: STC vs NOCT conditions, temperature coefficients
4. Monocrystalline vs polycrystalline vs thin-film: which to choose in Kenya
5. Panel ratings in practice: 100 W STC does not mean 100 W on your roof
6. Tilt angle calculation for Kenya latitudes (equator to 4°S)
7. Shade analysis: the one-module-in-shade problem and bypass diodes
8. Series vs parallel stringing: when and why

lessons.title: Battery Systems & Bank Sizing
lessons.titleSw: Mifumo ya Betri na Upimaji wa Benki
lessons.outline:
1. Battery chemistry overview: lead-acid (FLA, AGM, Gel) vs lithium (LiFePO4)
2. Key parameters: capacity (Ah), voltage, depth of discharge (DoD), cycle life
3. The C-rating: why a 100 Ah battery is not always 100 Ah
4. State of Charge (SoC): voltage tables, hydrometer readings, coulomb counting
5. Sizing a battery bank: autonomy days, DoD, efficiency losses
6. Worked example: sizing for a typical Kenyan household (lights, phone, radio, TV)
7. Battery wiring: series, parallel, series-parallel; cable sizing to battery terminals
8. Maintenance: equalisation, watering, temperature compensation

lessons.title: Charge Controllers & System Sizing
lessons.titleSw: Vidhibiti vya Chaji na Upimaji wa Mfumo
lessons.outline:
1. PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) controllers: operation, losses, when to use
2. MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) controllers: operation, 10-30% energy gain
3. Controller current rating: panel Isc × 1.25 safety factor
4. MPPT voltage window: Voc array must not exceed controller Voc input rating
5. Load survey: auditing household loads accurately
6. Panel array sizing: peak sun hours for Kenya, derating factors
7. Complete worked example: 12 V 150 W system for a rural household
8. System wiring order and common mistakes that destroy controllers

lessons.title: DC Wiring, Fusing & Safety
lessons.titleSw: Uwiring wa DC, Fyuzi na Usalama
lessons.outline:
1. DC circuit fundamentals: Ohm's law, power, and why DC wiring differs from AC
2. Voltage drop: the 3% rule and the voltage-drop formula
3. Cable sizing: cross-section selection tables for DC solar systems
4. Fuse and circuit breaker selection: where to fuse, what rating to use
5. Connector types: MC4, Anderson, ring terminals — crimping vs soldering
6. Earthing and bonding: why and how to earth a DC solar system
7. DC distribution boards and bus bars for larger systems
8. Common wiring faults and how to identify them before energising

lessons.title: Commissioning & Fault-Finding with a Multimeter
lessons.titleSw: Uanzishaji na Utambuzi wa Hitilafu kwa Multimeter
lessons.outline:
1. Multimeter functions: DC voltage, AC voltage, current (DC clamp), resistance, continuity
2. Safe multimeter practice: lead placement, range selection, avoiding common injuries
3. Commissioning sequence: the 8-step process for a new solar installation
4. Verifying panel output: Voc test, Isc test (with clamp meter)
5. Verifying charge controller operation: bulk, absorption, float stage indicators
6. Fault tree: battery not charging — step-by-step differential diagnosis
7. Fault tree: loads not working — isolating controller, fuse, cable, or load fault
8. PHOTO_CAPTURE practical: document your multimeter measurements on a real or simulated system

lessons.titleSw: Kilimo cha Kuokoa Maji — Mashimo ya Zai, Mifereji na Umwagiliaji

lessons.title: Agroforestry & Nitrogen-Fixing Trees
lessons.titleSw: Kilimo Msitu na Miti ya Kukuza Naitrojeni

lessons.title: Seed Saving, Variety Selection & Open-Pollinated Crops

lessons.titleSw: Uchunguzi wa Kitabibu, Viashiria vya Uhai na Fiziolojia ya Wanyama Wacheuaji
lessons.outline: Large animal handling and physical restraint (cattle nose tongs, tail jack, halter, casting ropes using the Reuff method); systematic clinical examination sequence (distance appraisal, head-to-tail physical exam); normal vital sign tables (cattle, sheep/goats, camels, donkeys: temperature, pulse, respiration); mucous membrane evaluation (conjunctival and vulvar capillary refill time); superficial lymph node palpation (prescapular, precrural, submandibular); the 4-chambered ruminant stomach; rumen motility auscultation in the left paralumbar fossa (2 to 3 contractions every 2 minutes); acute bloat pathophysiology (frothy vs free-gas); emergency trocharization and administration of vegetable oil / dimethicone anti-foaming agents.

lessons.title: Vector-Borne Livestock Diseases — ECF & Trypanosomiasis
lessons.titleSw: Magonjwa ya Mifugo Yanayoenezwa na Wadudu — Ndigana (ECF) na Nagana
lessons.outline: East Coast Fever (Theileria parva): vector Rhipicephalus appendiculatus (brown ear tick); pathogenesis (lymphoproliferation, Koch's Blue Bodies in lymph node aspirate smears, pulmonary oedema death); treatment: Buparvaquone (2.5 mg/kg IM) + long-acting oxytetracycline; ITM (Infection and Treatment Method) live vaccine protocol; Trypanosomiasis (T. congolense, T. vivax, T. brucei): vector Glossina spp. (tsetse fly); clinical picture (intermittent fever, progressive cachexia, 'razor-back', jugular pulse); diagnosis: wet blood mount, buffy coat microhaematocrit centrifuge technique; curative vs prophylactic drugs: Diminazene aceturate (Berenil) vs Isometamidium chloride; tsetse fly biconical / Nzi blue fabric traps with attractant odor lures.

lessons.title: Pastoral Vaccine Management & Biosecurity Protocols
lessons.titleSw: Usimamizi wa Chanjo za Mifugo na Mipango ya Kuzuia Magonjwa (Biosecurity)
lessons.outline: High-consequence pastoral epizootics: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis), Blackquarter (Clostridium chauvoei), CBPP (Mycoplasma mycoides), Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), and PPR (goat plague); the veterinary cold chain (+2°C to +8°C requirements, conditioned icepacks in vaccine carriers); live lyophilized vaccines vs killed bacterin toxoids; reconstitution rules (sterile diluents, 2-hour field viability window); injection site anatomy: Subcutaneous (SC) loose neck tenting vs Intramuscular (IM) triangular neck zone; syringe calibration and automatic multi-dose drenchers; the fatal Anthrax biosecurity rule: sudden death with dark unclotted blood from orifices, strict prohibition of necropsy/slaughter, and 2-metre deep pit burial with quicklime.

lessons.title: Livestock Obstetrics, Dystocia & Emergency Wound Care
lessons.titleSw: Uzazi wa Mifugo, Kufungua Uzazi Uliokwama (Dystocia) na Matibabu ya Vidonda
lessons.outline: The three normal stages of ruminant parturition (cervical dilation, fetal expulsion, placental expulsion); normal anterior presentation (two front hooves pointing downward, head resting on knees); defining Dystocia causes (maternal-fetal disproportion, uterine inertia, fetal malpresentation); internal examination hygiene (chlorhexidine/soap, copious methylcellulose lubricant); correcting leg flexions (carpal/shoulder) and head back deviations; calving ropes/chains placement (double half-hitch above and below fetlock); traction timing with maternal labor contractions; caudal epidural anesthesia (lignocaine into Co1-Co2 space); post-partum uterine prolapse replacement; traumatic wound management (debridement, povidone-iodine flushing, interrupted mattress sutures, fly strike/myiasis treatment).

lessons.title: Acaricide Plunge Dips & Parasite Resistance Management
lessons.titleSw: Mabwawa ya Kuoshea Ng'ombe (Plunge Dips) na Kuzuia Usugu wa Wadudu
lessons.outline: Communal plunge dip architecture: collection crush, footbath silt traps, 15,000L deep swim tank, splash curtains, draining race with sump return; acaricide chemical classes: Amidines (Amitraz 0.025%), Synthetic Pyrethroids (Deltamethrin / Cypermethrin), Organophosphates (Chlorfenvinphos); the 'Stripping' phenomenon (ticks and hair removing chemical faster than water); dip wash titration testing protocols (testing chemical active ingredient strength); topping-up and reinforcement arithmetic; operating mechanical spray races; managing acaricide resistance (chemical class rotation every 2-3 years, refugia maintenance); PHOTO_CAPTURE assessment rubric of livestock examination, dip facility, or veterinary equipment.

lessons.title: Wind Resource Assessment, Turbine Aerodynamics & Site Selection
lessons.titleSw: Tathmini ya Rasilimali ya Upepo, Aerodynamics ya Turbine na Uchaguzi wa Tovuti
lessons.outline: Wind as kinetic energy in moving air mass; the wind power density equation P = 0.5 × ρ × A × v³ (air density ρ = 1.225 kg/m³ at sea level, 15°C); the cubic velocity relationship and its dramatic implications (doubling wind speed multiplies power by 8x); the Betz Limit derivation (Albert Betz, 1919): maximum theoretical power extraction coefficient Cp(max) = 16/27 = 0.593; real turbine Cp values (well-designed HAWT 0.35–0.45); wind resource statistics: mean wind speed, Weibull distribution shape (k) and scale (c) parameters; capacity factor definition; wind shear and the wind speed profile power law exponent α (roughness coefficient 0.10 for open flat terrain, 0.25 for wooded agricultural land, 0.40 for forests and suburban areas); tower height calculation and the 10/90 rule (10% increase in height yields approximately 1% increase in mean wind speed in flat terrain); turbulence intensity (TI) measurement and maximum acceptable TI < 18% for grid-connected; site selection criteria: topographic acceleration on ridgelines and hill summits, wind roses, obstacle clearance (2H rule and 10D rule); anemometer data logging protocols and wind data quality control.

lessons.title: HAWT Construction — Blade Carving, Alternator Winding & Furling Tail
lessons.titleSw: Ujenzi wa Turbine ya Upepo — Kukata Mabawa, Kufunga Alternator na Mkia wa Kuzuia
lessons.outline: Blade aerodynamic theory: lift force on an aerofoil section (Bernoulli and circulation theories); angle of attack and chord width variation from hub to tip (twist distribution); Tip Speed Ratio (TSR) definition: blade tip velocity / wind speed; optimal TSR for maximum Cp (3-blade HAWT: TSR 5–8; 2-blade HAWT: TSR 7–10; Savonius VAWT: TSR 0.7–1.0); blade planform design: chord width taper (wider at root, narrow at tip), blade twist (higher pitch angle at root, flatter at tip); wood species selection for blade carving (Sitka spruce, Douglas fir, or local hardwoods — grain straight with < 2° slope of grain); carving sequence: centre-line marking, flat back face, leading edge radius, trailing edge taper, surface finishing and epoxy/varnish sealing; static rotor balancing with a pivot-point balance check; axial-flux permanent magnet alternator (PMA) design: multi-pole configuration (12 poles = 6 pole pairs), 3-phase star-wound stator coil calculation (turns per coil from target voltage); magnet rotor casting in glass-fibre reinforced polyester resin discs; coil winding machine and insulation; passive furling tail: offset hinge geometry, tail boom length, and furling wind speed design target; tower and guy-wire erection with gin-pole raising technique.

lessons.title: Micro-Hydro Site Survey, Pelton Wheel Design & Penstock Hydraulics
lessons.titleSw: Uchunguzi wa Tovuti ya Mto, Ubunifu wa Gurudumu la Pelton na Mfumo wa Bomba
lessons.outline: The micro-hydro power equation: P = η × ρ × g × Q × H (system efficiency η 0.55–0.80; water density ρ = 1000 kg/m³; g = 9.81 m/s²; flow rate Q m³/s; net head H metres); gross head vs net head: subtracting penstock friction losses (Darcy-Weisbach friction head loss formula hf = f × L/D × v²/2g); site survey methods: hand level with graduated staff, Abney level, smartphone barometric altimeter, differential GPS; flow measurement techniques: the bucket-and-stopwatch method (Q = volume/time); velocity-area method (current meter and cross-section area); the 90-degree V-notch weir formula Q = 1.38 × tan(θ/2) × h^2.5; flow duration curves and dry-season design flow (Q_design = Q_50 or Q_90 percentile); Pelton wheel operating principle (impulse turbine: jets of water strike cup-shaped buckets converting kinetic energy to rotation); jet velocity from Bernoulli equation Vj = Cv × √(2gH) where Cv = 0.97; Pelton wheel speed: optimal bucket speed = 0.46 × Vj; bucket sizing and jet-to-wheel diameter ratio; penstock pipe material selection (HDPE, galvanized steel, PVC); pipe diameter sizing using maximum allowable velocity 2.0–3.0 m/s; surge protection (air chambers, slow-close valve); siting the intake weir, gravel trap, forebay tank, and penstock.

lessons.title: Power Electronics — Charge Controllers, Dump Loads & Battery Banks
lessons.titleSw: Elektroniki ya Nguvu — Vidhibiti vya Chaji, Mzigo wa Ziada na Betri
lessons.outline: The voltage-current relationship of a battery (State of Charge vs terminal voltage curve for lead-acid 12V: 11.8V empty, 12.7V full; lithium LiFePO4: 12.0V empty, 13.6V full); battery bank sizing: Load (Wh/day) / (Battery voltage × DoD × efficiency) = Ampere-hours required; Depth of Discharge (DoD): lead-acid maximum 50% DoD for longevity; LiFePO4 80% DoD; days of autonomy (2–5 days typical for wind/hydro hybrid); battery C-rate and maximum charge current; PWM charge controllers (simple series switch; efficient only when panels output == battery voltage); MPPT controllers (DC-DC boost/buck converter; 20–30% more efficient for wind when generator output varies with wind speed); dump load (diversion load) controllers for wind: voltage-sensing relay or MOSFET switches excess power to a resistive ballast heater when battery bank reaches float voltage; the Electronic Load Controller (ELC) for micro-hydro AC systems: maintains constant electrical load (ballast heating element) at exactly rated generator power to hold constant turbine speed and frequency; three-phase vs single-phase ELC design; inverter types (modified sine wave vs pure sine wave); sizing the inverter (VA rating = peak AC load × 1.25 safety factor); system protection: main DC fuse (1.25 × maximum current), DC breakers, earthing electrode, lightning surge arrestors.

lessons.title: System Integration, Load Analysis & Hybrid Wind-Solar-Hydro Design
lessons.titleSw: Muunganiko wa Mfumo, Uchambuzi wa Mzigo na Muundo wa Mseto wa Upepo-Jua-Mto
lessons.outline: Detailed load analysis: appliance inventory (rated power W, hours/day use, Wh/day); peak load analysis for inverter and cable sizing; load scheduling to shift non-essential loads to generation-rich periods; system sizing methodology: energy balance over the worst-case month (minimum generation vs maximum load); hybrid system architectures: DC-coupled (all sources charge a common DC battery bus via charge controllers) vs AC-coupled (all sources invert to a common AC bus; AC coupling uses a grid-forming inverter); micro-hydro base load + wind/solar peak supplement design; diesel/petrol generator backup integration (auto-start on battery depth of discharge alarm); system monitoring: current/voltage/energy data loggers; wire sizing using allowable voltage drop criterion (< 2% on DC runs, < 5% on AC runs); conduit and junction box installation; community energy co-operative governance: tariff structures, metering, revenue collection, maintenance fund allocation; system commissioning sequence: pre-energization checks, first energization, load testing, turbine run-up procedure, protection relay testing; PHOTO_CAPTURE field assessment.
